start: WhatsApp chat with the gym's invite link app.mettleup.fit/j/<CODE>; an Android phone without the MettleUp app

steps.action: Look at the link preview in WhatsApp
user_sees: Title 'Join <gym> on MettleUp'
Line '<gym> invites you to the MettleUp app. Tap to join. Gym code <CODE>.'
The gym's logo
must_not: Another gym's name or logo
A plain MettleUp preview when the gym exists

user_sees: Page 'Join your gym' / 'on the MettleUp app' with the gym filled in
'First, get the MettleUp app' with three numbered steps
Button 'Get it on Google Play'
The gym code in the box under 'Or type your gym’s code in the app'
must_not: An endless spinner
A store redirect that loses the gym code

user_sees: The MettleUp listing in Google Play
must_not: Another app's listing
An error page

start: The same link opened on an iPhone; APP_STORE_URL is empty (today)

steps.action: Tap the link on the iPhone
user_sees: The gym page with 'The iPhone app is coming soon'
'Until then, the front desk at <gym> can add you as a member. You do not need the app for that.'
must_not: A jump to Google Play
A blank page

start: The same link opened on a laptop browser

steps.action: Open the link on the computer
user_sees: 'Open this link on your phone'
'Scan this QR code with your phone’s camera.'
Badges 'GET IT ON Google Play' and 'App Store Coming soon'
must_not: A redirect to a store on the computer
A QR code for another address

start: A link with a code that is no gym (/j/ZZZ999) or with 7 letters

user_sees: The join page without any gym filled in; the server answers 'not found' (404) (the page's exact words for this case not read)
must_not: Another gym's name, logo or code
A server error page

start: The owner has just changed the gym's name and logo; the link was opened before the change

steps.action: Open the link again within 5 minutes of the change
user_sees: The old name and logo may still show (kept 5 minutes per code)
must_not: A mix of old name and new logo for longer than 5 minutes

user_sees: 'Join <new name> on MettleUp' and the new logo
must_not: The old name still shown

start: Anyone who has the link opens it

steps.action: Open the link and read the page source and preview
user_sees: Only the gym's public name, logo and join code
must_not: Any member's name or number
The owner's phone number
Another gym's data

start: A member of the gym with the MettleUp app on an Android phone gets the gym's link

user_sees: The MettleUp app opens at joining <gym> (Android App Link; the app's words not read here)
must_not: The browser page asking to install an app that is already installed

start: The link opens in a browser on a phone that has the app (for example inside WhatsApp's own browser)

user_sees: The app opens on the join step for <gym>; without the app, Google Play opens instead
must_not: A page that does nothing when tapped
The gym code lost on the way

start: The member types the link by hand with lower-case letters (/j/abc123) or with a wrong letter

user_sees: The same gym page (the code is read in capitals)
must_not: A 'not found' for a right code in lower case

steps.action: Open a link with one wrong letter
user_sees: The page without a gym (not found)
must_not: A different gym that happens to have that code shown as if it were theirs without its name

start: The gym has changed its logo since the member last opened the link

steps.action: Open the link after the change
user_sees: The new logo within 5 minutes
must_not: The old logo for longer than 5 minutes
A broken picture
